function.name: DispInvoke
function.description: This function invokes a method on a given object using the provided type information and method arguments, and returns the result, exception information, and bad argument if any.

parameters.name: _this
parameters.description: Object to call method on

parameters.name: ptinfo
parameters.description: Object type info

parameters.name: dispidMember
parameters.description: DISPID of the member (e.g. from GetIDsOfNames())

parameters.name: wFlags
parameters.description: Kind of method call (DISPATCH_ flags from 'oaidl.h')

parameters.name: pparams
parameters.description: Array of method arguments

parameters.name: pvarResult
parameters.description: Destination for the result of the call

parameters.name: pexcepinfo
parameters.description: Destination for exception information

parameters.name: puArgErr
parameters.description: Destination for bad argument

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the method call, success or failure

function.name: DispGetIDsOfNames
function.description: This function gets the DISPIDs for an array of names.

parameters.name: ptinfo
parameters.description: Object's type info

parameters.name: rgszNames
parameters.description: Array of names to get DISPIDs for

parameters.name: cNames
parameters.description: Number of names in rgszNames

parameters.name: rgdispid
parameters.description: Destination for converted DISPIDs

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation

function.name: DispGetParam
function.description: This function is used to get a parameter from a list and coerce its type. The position of the parameter is counted backwards. If the parameter is not found or any error occurs, it returns an error code.

parameters.name: pdispparams
parameters.description: Parameter list

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position of parameter to coerce in pdispparams

parameters.name: vtTarg
parameters.description: Type of value to coerce to

parameters.name: pvarResult
parameters.description: Destination for resulting variant

parameters.name: puArgErr
parameters.description: Destination for error code

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the operation fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: impl_from_IDispatch
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: StdDispatch* - This represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: StdDispatch_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the requested interface (identified by riid) is supported. If it is, it increments the reference count and returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that the caller is querying.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: If the interface is supported, upon return, contains the address of the pointer to that interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise.

function.name: StdDispatch_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the StdDispatch object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the StdDispatch object from the IDispatch interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: StdDispatch_Release
function.description: This function releases the interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases the type information and frees the memory.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement.

function.name: StdDispatch_GetTypeInfoCount
function.description: This function sets the value of the pointer pctinfo to 1 and returns a success status code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

parameters.name: pctinfo
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a UINT. The function sets its value to 1.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status code of the function execution. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating successful execution.

function.name: StdDispatch_GetTypeInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the type information for an object, which can be used to get the type information for an interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that the client is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: iTInfo
parameters.description: Specifies the type information to return. If this parameter is zero, the type information is retrieved for the object's class.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: The locale identifier for the type information.

parameters.name: ppTInfo
parameters.description: Receives a pointer to the requested type information object.

function.return_type: HRESULT and it represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: StdDispatch_GetIDsOfNames
function.description: This function retrieves the IDs for a specified set of names.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier.

parameters.name: rgszNames
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of names.

parameters.name: cNames
parameters.description: Count of the names.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier.

parameters.name: rgDispId
parameters.description: Pointer to the array where the function will store the IDs corresponding to the names.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the riid is not equal to IID_NULL, otherwise it returns the result of DispGetIDsOfNames function.

function.name: StdDispatch_Invoke
function.description: This function invokes a method or property through IDispatch interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface.

parameters.name: dispIdMember
parameters.description: Identifier of the member.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale context.

parameters.name: wFlags
parameters.description: Flags describing the context of the invoke call.

parameters.name: pDispParams
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing an array of arguments.

parameters.name: pVarResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the result is to be stored.

parameters.name: pExcepInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains exception information.

parameters.name: puArgErr
parameters.description: If Invoke returns DISP_E_TYPEMISMATCH, this output parameter receives the index of the first argument that has an incorrect type.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns E_INVALIDARG if the riid is not IID_NULL.

function.name: CreateStdDispatch
function.description: This function creates a standard dispatch object, allocating memory for it and setting its properties.

parameters.name: punkOuter
parameters.description: Pointer to the outer unknown interface.

parameters.name: pvThis
parameters.description: Pointer to the object.

parameters.name: ptinfo
parameters.description: Pointer to the type information interface.

parameters.name: stddisp
parameters.description: Double pointer to the unknown interface of the standard dispatch object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if any of the arguments is invalid, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.
